title: Anyone else finding AI narrative tools that show scenes instead of just text?
author: OwlZealousideal4779
selftext: Ive been experimenting with different AI setups for solo story games and most of them just dump long text responses. Fun at first but I lose focus pretty quick. Recently spent some time with LiveTale and it felt a bit different because every scene gets illustrated as you play so you can actually see the character and the situation instead of only reading about it. You still type what the hero tries and there are dice that can fail which keeps some of the game structure. Quests and inventory carry over too. Not claiming its perfect but it scratched the itch of wanting visuals without losing the interactive part. Curious what other people are using when they want AI storytelling that goes beyond pure chat. Anyone found tools or workflows that do something similar with consistent scene images?

comments.author: Hopeful-Remote9484
comments.body: the visuals are probably the biggest thing missing from most AUistory stuff right now. Text is fine but actually seeing the scene change based one what you do makes it feel way more like a game
